title: What Is the Dayli ICC 1M Entry Model?
hook: Has price actually earned my entry?

launchpad.outcome: Separate higher-timeframe analysis from 1M execution, and name the six steps of the model.
launchpad.missionQuestion: Has price actually earned my entry?

slides.question: Now… how do I actually enter?
lines: The 1M doesn’t create the whole trade idea.
You already know the market, the structure, the direction, the location and the story.

slides.title: Analysis gets me interested. Execution earns the entry.
PIL → I → C → C → Retest → Entry

questions.continuation: Did price close back in the original direction?
questions.retest: Did price return to the PIL?
questions.entry: Did my execution opportunity actually arrive?

slides.principle: STOP ANTICIPATING THE MOVE. MAKE PRICE PROVE EVERY STEP.

slides.quote: The analysis gets me interested. The 1-minute ICC earns the entry.

slides.prompt: What’s the difference between higher-timeframe analysis and Dayli ICC 1M execution?
slides.modelAnswer: Analysis tells me the story, direction, structure and location. Execution answers one question: has price actually earned my entry, step by step, with candle closes.

takeaways: PIL → I → C → C → Retest → Entry.
remember: The analysis gets me interested. The 1-minute ICC earns the entry.
